newsitem.title: USA: Unocal calls domestic E&P unit Spirit Energy.
newsitem.headline: Unocal calls domestic E&P unit Spirit Energy.

text.p: Unocal Corp on Wednesday announced its will call its new domestic crude oil and natural gas unit "Spirit Energy 76."
The new unit makes up about 35 percent of the company's worldwide crude oil production and 55 percent of the worldwide natural gas production, the company said in a statement.
Spirit will have exploration and production operations in Alabama, Texas, Louisiana, Michigan, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Utah, as well as offshore operations in the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Last year, Unocal announced the realignment of its worldwide oil and gas activities into two business units -- one that would focus on domestic activities and a second that would explore overseas.
The company agreed in November to sell its refining and marketing operations to Tosco Corp for about $2 billion by this quarter.
Spirit Energy 76 will continue to explore its established fields, but the business unit will also look at possible acquisitions and joint ventures, said Jack Schanck, president of Spirit Energy 76 .
